**Triage: lands in `.github/workflows/pre-install-import-graph.yml` (header) and the pin family in `scripts/__tests__/`; rationale: a workflow header states a derived population count that is false about the run it describes.**

Re-measured on `origin/main` at 2026-09-10T13:4xZ, independently of the card:

```
git ls-tree --name-only origin/main -- .github/workflows/ | wc -l   ->  35
```

⇒ the header still says 24; the directory holds **35**. Stale by 11, and still live two days after filing.

### Both halves are in scope, and the second is the durable one

**1. The number.** Correct it — or, better, stop stating a count that has to be maintained by hand.

**2. ⭐ The blindness, which is why this recurs.** The card establishes two independent reasons objectui#7448's document-count pin family could not have caught this: no pin reads this header (`POPULATION_COUNT` lives in exactly three test files, none pointed here — `git grep -l`, three hits, nonsense control `ZZQQNOTATOKEN` exits 1), **and** the count wraps across a comment line, so even a pin aimed at this header would miss it under a per-line unit.

⚠️ That second point is a **scanner blind spot**, which SKILL.md names as a non-escalating accounting class when the change *strengthens* the instrument. ⇒ the dev may extend the pin family to this header and make the wrapped-line case readable. ⛔ It may **not** weaken any existing pin, lower a threshold, or delete a check to make this pass — that is gate-weakening and sits on the maintainer floor.

⚠️ Related but ⛔ **not** to be merged into this card: objectui#8629 covers the same "stated count with no measurement point" shape on `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, and comment 5589736321 there records that the pin carriers run their pattern over **joined** text, not per line — the same wrapped-line subtlety from the other end. Read it before choosing the unit; ⛔ do not fix that card's counts here.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — the header edit is trivial, the pin extension needs judgement about the unit.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#8995, and ⭐ the count moved again while the card was being dispatched

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T16:13Z. Verified against the tree.

`origin/main` = `4d65991c5`, **tip committed 2026-09-10T15:31:10Z**; head `ded73e00d`, **committed 16:03:55Z**. Two files, **+233 / −5**. No model identifier in the commits.

### ⭐ The finding that makes the whole argument for the fix

The card measured the directory at **35**. Triage re-measured it at **35** the next day. The dev measured **36**. This seat's own count on `origin/main` agrees: **36** (nonsense control: 0).

⇒ ⭐ **the population grew again in the hours between triage and dispatch.** A hand-corrected literal would already have been stale before the pull request opened. ⛔ That is not a rhetorical point about maintenance burden — it is the measurement that rules out the cheap fix, and it arrived by accident.

### What landed instead of a number

The header now says, in its own words, ⛔ 「No population count here, deliberately」 — and names the directory the gate **derives** from plus the command that prints the live reading. ⭐ That is the shape this repository has now converged on independently four times: **point at the instrument, never copy its answer.** The adjacent hand-count of `scripts/` gates (「a dozen」 against 26 distinct) went the same way rather than being left as the next thing to rot.

### ⭐ The unit decision was measured, not argued

The wrapped-line question — the reason a pin aimed at this header would still have missed it — was settled by running the family's pattern **byte for byte** over all 36 headers both ways:

| extraction | hits |
|:--|--:|
| markers **kept** | 9 |
| markers **stripped** | 11 |

⇒ the two extra are exactly this workflow and one other, and an in-class control in the same run shows a wrapped count reading `[]` under the keeping unit and a real hit under the stripping one — ⭐ so the `[]` is a **silence being demonstrated**, ⛔ not an absence being assumed. All three existing carriers already strip and argue for it verbatim, so the choice **follows the family** rather than inventing a fourth convention. Both legs are pinned, with the marker-keeping extraction kept **as a control** asserting `[]` on the wrapped fixture.

### The gate can fail — proven twice, on the committed tree

Leg A restores the literal count ⇒ the new pin **fails** (「states no count that adding a workflow would falsify」). Leg B removes the pointer ⇒ it **fails** (「names the directory the gate actually derives the population from」). Each carries an on-disk mutation proof — injected-text grep, deleted-text grep, and a blob hash differing from `HEAD` — and each restore is proven by an **empty `git diff HEAD`**, ⛔ not by an exit code. ⭐ And an empty `hash-object` result was treated as a **failure** rather than as a pass.

### ⛔ The floor held, and this seat checked it rather than taking the report's word

The three existing `POPULATION_COUNT` carriers appear **0** times in the diff — ⛔ not one was edited — and they run 97 tests at exit 0 both before (with the changed files restored to the base) and after. ⇒ nothing weakened, no threshold lowered, no check deleted, no scan surface narrowed. This card's authorisation was to **strengthen** the instrument, and it added the **fourth** carrier rather than loosening the other three.

⛔ Fences held: `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` untouched and objectui#8629 still open with its counts unaddressed; the sibling dev's three spawner test files untouched, so the two sets stay disjoint; `content/docs/releases/**` untouched.

⚠️ Recorded and ⛔ deliberately not acted on: three other workflow headers carry population counts no pin reads. The card fences that, and the question already has two owners (objectui#7966, objectui#8535). ⭐ Reported so the reading is not lost, ⛔ not folded in.
